name: Cloudflare Wrangler
summary: A Cloudflare Workers command-line interface that discovers project configuration, runs local development workflows, and coordinates deployment and resource operations against the Cloudflare platform.

features.name: Configuration-driven command surface
features.description: Wrangler exposes command namespaces such as dev and deploy and resolves a Workers project configuration to determine the application and bindings those commands operate on.
benefits: Gives project automation a versioned, scriptable CLI boundary
Keeps deployment inputs close to the project configuration
costs: Configuration discovery and environment selection can change command behavior
The CLI surface must track platform API and configuration evolution

features.name: Local edge development loop
features.description: Wrangler provides a dev workflow and programmatic development helpers that start a local Workers execution environment while translating configured bindings and environment data for local use.
benefits: Shortens the edit-run-observe loop for Workers applications
Allows local testing before a remote deployment
costs: Local behavior depends on simulator and compatibility support
A local environment is not identical to every managed platform service

features.name: Platform operation adapters
features.description: Wrangler organizes commands and helpers for deploying Workers and managing platform resources, using Cloudflare APIs behind a CLI-oriented adapter boundary.
benefits: Provides one automation entry point for application and platform operations
Makes remote operations composable with CI workflows
costs: Credentials, network access, and remote API availability are required
Resource semantics remain governed by Cloudflare rather than the CLI

mathematical_views.question: How do a project configuration, selected environment, command namespace, and platform operation form a valid execution path?
assumptions: Configuration fields are modeled as inputs to command nodes
Bindings and credentials are abstracted as validated edges
The graph describes dispatch and dependencies, not remote success

mathematical_views.question: Which local execution and binding steps refine a Workers project toward a remotely deployed edge workload?
assumptions: Local simulation and remote execution share a relevant Worker contract
Platform services may have behavior not represented locally
The model does not assert behavioral equivalence
